title: Establishment of Special Courts for rape trials
text: (1) The Federal Government, in consultation with the Chief Justice of the High Court, shall establish Special Courts to try scheduled rape and sexual assault offences with designated trial timelines of six months.
source_file: Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk) / Official Gazette, Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Act, 2021
text_normalized: (1) The Federal Government, in consultation with the Chief Justice of the High Court, shall establish Special Courts to try scheduled rape and sexual assault offences with designated trial timelines of six months.

title: Prohibition of two-finger virginity test
text: No medical examination of a female victim of a scheduled offence shall include any virginity test, hymen examination or two-finger test, which is hereby strictly prohibited and illegal.
source_file: Pakistan Code (pakistancode.gov.pk) / Official Gazette, Anti-Rape (Investigation and Trial) Act, 2021
